attacker_baseline_stake.meaning: attacker's baseline stake held before the boundary deposit, comparable to passive users
attacker_baseline_stake.checkpoint: before boundary deposit in epoch e

boundary_deposit_offset.meaning: offset of the boundary deposit time from epochTimestampEnd(e); report states it is 1 epoch time unit before epoch end

claim_target_prev_epoch_offset.meaning: offset from current epoch e+1 to the epoch targeted by claim logic (prevEpoch = e), i.e. 1 epoch back

boundary_utilization_credited.meaning: personal utilization credited for epoch e from the boundary deposit added immediately before epoch end

full_epoch_utilization_reference.meaning: utilization the same stake would accrue if held for the full epoch e

emissions_extraction_pressure_observed.meaning: extraction pressure on emissions distribution from boundary-timing behavior is present

assumptions: The attacker's baseline stake is a pre-existing position comparable to passive users' stakes.
The boundary deposit is temporary and is exited shortly after the boundary in epoch e+1.
Claim logic in epoch e+1 targets prevEpoch = e, so the boundary deposit affects the epoch e claim.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric values for the reward differential or the realized unwind cost, so the comparative intent i_reward_not_exceed_unwind_cost cannot be quantified; only the qualitative extraction-pressure impact is formalized here.
Report does not quantify epoch boundary timestamp semantics beyond 'epochTimestampEnd(e) - 1'; the offset is bound to literal 1 epoch time unit but the absolute timestamp is symbolic.

limitations: Only the emissions_extraction_pressure impact is formalized; inflated_reward_capture and honest_user_dilution are handled in separate claim-generation passes.

The proportional-fairness relation is expressed at the utilization-amount level (credited utilization vs full-epoch reference) rather than as a reward-rate ratio, since the report gives no rate definition.
The extraction-pressure observable is a qualitative Boolean because the report provides no numeric magnitude for the pressure itself.
